craft_notes: Sthāyin: wonder at thoroughness (every joint). Sanskrit first: scope (each limb), locus (joints), intensification (heart swirls), cause (true knowledge power) → L4 sets scope+locus line 1, heart+cause line 2. Rows: row 3 (each/distributive doubled — 'each single/each joint'). Rupture: semicolon after 'part' — limbs done, heart begins. Close: end-weight on the power ('art' — prabhāva as mastery). Minimal pass: 'art' for power (mastery singable; force-doctrine kept in cite). Read aloud: line 1 ticks joint by joint (each/each), semicolon, line 2 churns (churns round/art round vowels). Rejected: causative flattened ('limbs whirl') — killed at L0 (she whirls, limbs are whirled); 'wisdom' for vidyā — killed: knowledge kept (vidyā is knowing-power, not sage-advice).

lines: Each single limb it whirls, each joint of limb and part;
his heart churns round, by true knowledge's art.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ekaikaṃ bhramayaty aṅgam aṅgapratyaṅgasaṃdhiṣu / ghūrṇate hṛdayaṃ cāsya samyagvidyāprabhāvataḥ

reads_against.argmap: True knowledge whirls every limb in its joints; his heart swirls by that power.
c1_essence: Limb by limb the whirling spreads through the joints; the heart churns by true knowing.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta strained toward bhayānaka (wonder edged with fear)
